chunks: Ahmad b. al-Hasan al-Qattan narrated to us. He said: Abu Sa'id al-Sukkari narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Zakariyya informed us. He said: al-Abbas b. Bakkar narrated to us. He said: Abdullah b. al-Muthanna narrated to us from his uncle Thumama b. Abdullah from Anas b. Malik from his mother. She said:
Fatima (peace be upon them both) did not see blood during menstruation nor during postpartum bleeding.

key_terms.فاطمة: Fatima al-Zahra - the daughter of the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW), wife of Imam Ali (AS)
key_terms.نفاس: Nifas/postpartum bleeding - bleeding that occurs after childbirth

ai.seo_question: What miraculous quality regarding menstruation is attributed to Lady Fatima al-Zahra?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a miraculous quality attributed to Lady Fatima al-Zahra (AS) -- that she never experienced menstrual blood or postpartum bleeding. This narration comes through the companion Anas b. Malik's mother, Umm Sulaym, who was close to the Prophet's household and would have had personal knowledge of such matters. In Shia tradition, this is understood as one of the signs of Fatima's exceptional purity, connecting to her Quranic epithet as one of the purified (33:33). The title 'al-Zahra' (the Radiant) is linked to this quality of extraordinary spiritual and physical purity.

en.bilal-muhammad: Ahmad b. al-Hasan al-Qattan narrated to us. He said: Abu Sa`id al-Sakri narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Zakariyya informed us. He said: al-`Abbas b. Bakkar narrated to us. He said: `Abdullah b. al-Muthanna narrated to us from his uncle Thumama b. `Abdullah from Anas b. Malik from his mother. She said:
Fatima (sa) did not see blood during menstruation nor in delivery.
